description: NL->SQL questions over the engine's `vessels` fixture: telemetry(ts TIMESTAMP, vessel VARCHAR, speed, wind, wave_height, water_temp, lat, lon DOUBLE), 6 vessels, 1-14 Sept 2026 every 6 s. Each case has hand-written reference SQL; the eval compares executed results, never SQL text. A list of references means several readings are acceptable (ambiguous questions). $SINCE(n unit) expands into `ts >= now - n`, `ts > now - n` and whole units (`ts >= date_trunc(unit, now) - (n-1) units`). References follow the result-shape convention: x first, then the series column, then values; ORDER BY x unless the question ranks.

cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, count(*) AS readings FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.reference: SELECT max(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.reference: SELECT avg(water_temp) AS water_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, min(speed) AS min_speed, max(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(2 days) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.reference: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, vessel, max(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.reference: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, min(water_temp) AS min_water_temp, max(water_temp) AS max_water_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND $SINCE(1 day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS t, vessel, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.reference: SELECT hour(ts) AS hour, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
reference: SELECT dayname(ts) AS weekday, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT isodow(ts) AS weekday, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT dayofweek(ts) AS weekday, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.note: Name or number of the weekday are both fine.

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts > TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, avg(water_temp) AS water_temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS t, avg(water_temp) AS water_temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.note: Bucket size is the model's choice: hourly or daily.

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
reference: SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(24 hours) GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY speed DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(24 hours) GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY speed DESC
cases.note: The single winner or the full ranking.

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(12 hours) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS minute, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(30 minutes) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-06' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-05' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-09-05' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS minute, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(1 hour) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel <> 'Aurora' AND $SINCE(1 day) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, count(*) AS readings FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 AND $SINCE(1 day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 AND $SINCE(1 day) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
cases.note: Fleet line or one line per vessel.

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Poseidon' AND $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.note: No such vessel: the honest answer is an empty result, not another vessel's data.

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.reference: SELECT count(DISTINCT date_trunc('hour', ts)) AS hours FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
reference:
-- view: table
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY wave_height DESC LIMIT 10

-- view: table
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY wave_height DESC LIMIT 10
cases.note: Per vessel-hour or fleet hour. Raw readings were not used: 5.73 m is tied across dozens of rows, so a raw top 20 is not deterministic.

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY speed DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.reference: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY wind DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
reference: SELECT vessel, min(water_temp) AS water_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY water_temp LIMIT 1
SELECT vessel FROM telemetry ORDER BY water_temp LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
reference: SELECT vessel, max(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY lon DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT vessel FROM telemetry ORDER BY lon DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, corr(wind, speed) AS correlation FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, max(water_temp) - min(water_temp) AS water_temp_range FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(speed) AS speed, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wave_height / wind) AS ratio FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(1 day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wave_height) / avg(wind) AS ratio FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(1 day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.note: Mean of ratios or ratio of means.

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, avg(speed) * 1.852 AS speed_kmh FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(1 day) GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
reference: SELECT vessel, avg(speed) FILTER (WHERE ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08') AS first_week, avg(speed) FILTER (WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08') AS second_week FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
SELECT CASE WHEN ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS week, vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
cases.note: Weeks are 1-7 and 8-14 September; wide or long layout.

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
reference: SELECT vessel, arg_max(lat, ts) AS lat, arg_max(lon, ts) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
SELECT vessel, max(ts) AS ts, arg_max(lat, ts) AS lat, arg_max(lon, ts) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
SELECT max(ts) AS ts, vessel, arg_max(lat, ts) AS lat, arg_max(lon, ts) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY ts, vessel
cases.note: With or without the timestamp; with it, time is x and vessel the series.

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-13' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-13' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS t, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-13' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.note: Yesterday = 13 September (the day before the data's latest day). Raw rows (14,400) break the 5000-row rule.

cases.question: show all vessel tracks on a map
reference:
-- view: tracks
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, vessel, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

-- view: tracks
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '30 minutes', ts) AS t, vessel, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
cases.note: Raw positions (1.2 M rows) break the row rule; hourly or half-hourly positions per vessel.

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, count(*) AS readings FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day
cases.reference: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average wave height per ves
cases.reference: SELECT vessel, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
cases.note: Typed live and unfinished: per vessel.

cases.question: wind
reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, vessel, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
cases.note: Any aggregated wind-over-time view is sensible; raw rows are not.

cases.question: speed last week
reference: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, vessel, avg(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
cases.note: Last 7 days counted back from the data's end; hourly or daily, fleet or per vessel.

cases.question: scatter of wind vs wave height
reference:
-- view: scatter
SELECT avg(wind) AS wind, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) ORDER BY 1

-- view: scatter
SELECT avg(wind) AS wind, vessel, avg(wave_height) AS wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts), vessel ORDER BY 1, 2
cases.note: 1.2 M raw points break the row rule; hourly means (fleet or per vessel) are a sensible scatter.
